deepAudit.interpretation: Audit coverage measures evidence resolution, not portal quality. Missing/unresolved is not scored as zero.

interpretation.iscRank: ISC classification rank inside the ISC class; independent from RTPMI.
interpretation.rtpmi: Portal maturity/transparency only; not research performance.
interpretation.missing: unresolved/not-found evidence is not proof of absence and is not automatically scored zero.
